name: Colour
description: Use when grading video or matching shots: balance shots against their neighbours first, match cameras by measured colour, protect skin tones, and apply a look last, at a strength the person chooses.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
